what: Hero cards scattered across the first screen drift slowly away from the cursor. Each card picks a horizontal range of 70~100 and a vertical range of −50~50px on load. Half of the cursor position, scaled to the window size, is mapped into that range, and the card eases toward the opposite of that value by 4% per frame, so each card gets a different depth (cards with a negative vertical range move inverted). On hover the inner plate scales to 1.08 over .8s expo.out and is pulled 30% of the distance toward the cursor (4% per frame). On release it returns to its place and size over 1s power4.out. Runs only while the plate is on screen.

options.range-x: Horizontal range picked per card (px, ‹small,large›), default 70,100
options.range-y: Vertical range picked per card (px), default −50,50
options.pull: Share of the card’s inner plate pulled toward the cursor on hover, default .3
options.[data-fx-part=card]: Floating card (position is set to absolute in the consumer’s css)
options.[data-fx-part=cover]: (if present) panel that grows and gets dragged inside the card — holds a photo or video

note: Not applied on touch devices (hover false) or reduced-motion settings — the original also turns the same cards into a horizontally flowing strip (marquee) on phones. When the cursor has not moved yet it counts as (0, 0), so the cards are pushed slightly to the lower right as soon as it opens (same as the original).
